_comment: Events: messages to a player, shown as the blinking buttons at the bottom of the side panel (right of the computer button). categories: per kind of event its button – slot: top left on the panel image (unscaled, panel space), icons: GUI images of file 03 [dark, lit]; name: hover text. blinkSeconds: how long a button blinks after an event; arrowSeconds: how long the arrows point at the place after jumping there (click on the button or space: the latest event). events: what triggers them – category, cooldownSeconds (per player: at most one such event in that time), text, enabled.

attacked._comment: One of the player's settlers (soldier, geologist, priest, …) or a military building's door is struck or shot at.
